scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @pokemon-universe/server" "npm run dev -w @pokemon-universe/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/shared && npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/server && npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pokemon-universe/server && npm run typecheck -w @pokemon-universe/web && npm run typecheck -w @pokemon-universe/e2e
scripts.test: npm run check:boundaries && npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
